info.description: Development API for mailbox policy, Stellar postage proofs, and delivery receipts.

StellarSignedRequest.description: Authenticates a Stellar account through the [SEP-10 Web Authentication](https://github.com/stellar/stellar-protocol/blob/master/ecosystem/sep-0010.md) challenge flow. Fetch a short-lived challenge transaction from the service's WEB_AUTH_ENDPOINT, verify the server signature and transaction fields, sign the challenge with an authorized Stellar account signer, and exchange the signed transaction for a token. Send that token on protected API calls as `Authorization: Bearer <SEP-10-token>`. Never send a Stellar secret seed. The server derives the actor from the verified token and enforces challenge expiry and replay protection; `x-stealth-address` alone is not proof of identity.
x-challenge-flow: Request a challenge transaction from the WEB_AUTH_ENDPOINT for the Stellar account.
Validate the challenge according to SEP-10 before signing it.
Sign the challenge with an authorized account signer and return the signed transaction.
Use the returned short-lived token in the Authorization header for protected operations.

post.summary: Recover account access with one recovery code (BETA-010)
post.description: Consumes a single unused recovery code, revokes ALL existing sessions for the account, and issues a brand-new session cookie. Unauthenticated by design ╬ô├ç├╢ the code itself is the credential. Idempotent when an x-idempotency-key is supplied.

requestBody.description: Account identifier and a single unused recovery code.

401.description: Unauthorized ╬ô├ç├╢ invalid or already used recovery code

post.summary: Regenerate one-time recovery codes (BETA-010)
post.description: Privilege-sensitive action. Requires a session with a recent password login; replaces the stored code set (hashes only), returns the plaintext codes exactly once, and revokes every OTHER session for the account. Idempotent when an x-idempotency-key is supplied.

requestBody.description: Empty JSON object ({}). The action is driven by the authenticated session.

200.description: New recovery code set (plaintext codes, shown once)

403.description: Forbidden ╬ô├ç├╢ recent login required for regeneration

409.description: Conflict ╬ô├ç├╢ codes changed concurrently or idempotency replay

get.description: Recovery-status safety model for the settings UI. Never returns code material ╬ô├ç├╢ only state and counters.

post.summary: Initialize privacy-safe mailbox policy defaults (BETA-023)
post.description: Idempotently initializes the beta mailbox policy defaults for the owner, persisting the off-chain policy and scheduling the matching testnet contract write. A retry never re-submits an identical write and never bumps the on-chain policy version.

get.description: Exposes the reconciliation state between the durable off-chain policy and the on-chain Policies contract. When the chain client is unavailable, reconciliation is derived from the durable write intent alone (pending write surfaced as testnet synchronization pending).

parameters.name: chainVersion
parameters.description: On-chain policy version reported by the Policies contract; supplied by the chain client wired by BETA-017.

post.summary: Provision an account (username, profile, wallet, policy)
post.description: Idempotently runs the transactional account-provisioning state machine: username reservation, profile defaults, wallet creation and mailbox policy initialization converge without leaving a partial active account. Repeated calls are safe against duplicate requests; an optional x-idempotency-key enables strict replay semantics.

requestBody.description: Provisioning intent. Email and username are required only when no account exists for the actor yet.

200.description: Provisioning progress after a completed or resumed run

409.description: Conflict ╬ô├ç├╢ username unavailable or provisioning previously failed

get.summary: Read the authenticated account's onboarding draft
get.description: Safe projection of the durable server-backed onboarding draft. Returns null when onboarding has not started. The account identity is resolved from the session cookie; no wallet address is ever accepted or returned.

200.description: Onboarding draft (or null when not started)

put.summary: Persist the onboarding draft for the authenticated account
put.description: Upserts the durable draft keyed by the session account. Duplicate saves can never create duplicates, and a refresh or a second device resumes from this authoritative state. Unknown fields (e.g. a wallet address) are rejected with 422.

post.summary: Complete onboarding for the authenticated account
post.description: Terminal, idempotent completion: converts the draft through the preserved policy-conversion rules, writes the chosen mailbox policy (only when the account still holds the provisioning default), and marks the onboarding completed. Replays of an already-completed onboarding return the stored result without re-writing anything. Supply an x-idempotency-key header to make network retries fully idempotent.

get.summary: Read provisioning progress for the authenticated account
get.description: Safe progress projection: provisioning state, completed steps, attempts and the last failure. Never exposes credentials, wallet seeds, or hashes.

404.description: Not Found ╬ô├ç├╢ no account or provisioning record

post.summary: Retry a failed provisioning run
post.description: Restarts a retryable provisioning flow from its first incomplete step. Only retryable flows may be restarted; active and in-flight flows are rejected with a deterministic 409.

200.description: Provisioning progress after the retry run

404.description: Not Found ╬ô├ç├╢ no account or provisioning record

409.description: Conflict ╬ô├ç├╢ provisioning in flight, already active, or attempts exhausted

post.summary: Verify an account with a delivered token
post.description: Consumes a single-use verification token and activates the account. Responses are generic: failures are expressed as token state and never reveal whether an account exists; replaying an already-verified token reports success so retries are safe.

200.description: Generic verification result; never reveals whether the account exists

post.summary: Resend the verification message for a pending account
post.description: Re-issues a verification token (invalidating the previous one) and delivers a new message. Responds identically for unknown and non-pending accounts to prevent account probing; the resend cooldown is enforced with 429.

200.description: Generic confirmation; the message was sent or intentionally not sent

503.description: The verification message could not be delivered

post.summary: Request a password reset email for an account
post.description: Issues a hashed, single-use password reset token delivered to the account email. Responds identically for existing and non-existing accounts to prevent enumeration; rate limits and cooldowns are enforced.

200.description: Generic confirmation; the message was sent or intentionally not sent

429.description: Password reset request is on cooldown or rate limited

503.description: The password reset message could not be delivered

post.summary: Complete password reset using a single-use token
post.description: Consumes a single-use password reset token, validates password policy, sets the new password, invalidates all other outstanding reset tokens, and revokes all active sessions for the user.

200.description: Password reset completed successfully and all active sessions revoked

400.description: Invalid or expired password reset token

409.description: Password reset token has already been used or superseded

422.description: Password does not meet policy requirements or validation failed

429.description: Too many failed attempts. Token is locked
